name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Which Model Is Actually Serving You? IRIS: Budgeted Black-Box Auditing of Model Substitution and Routing Dilution in LLM Gateways
items.dek: IRIS audits LLM gateway model substitution and routing dilution using only returned text, self-sizing query budget, and fingerprinting.
items.unproven: Robustness against adversarially-designed backends; applicability to non-text modalities or streaming inference; reproducibility on gateways beyond OpenRouter.

items.title: Classical Acceptance Is Not Hybrid Authentication: Measuring X.509 Verifier Semantics in Post-Quantum Migration
items.dek: Eight X.509 path-validation stacks accept hybrid post-quantum certificates on classical evidence alone, silently bypassing post-quantum verification.
items.unproven: Limited to tested stacks and certificate schemes; real-world deployment impact and remediation timeline for affected vendors not yet established.

items.title: IssueTrojanBench: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents Against Malicious Issue Requests
items.dek: 66.5% of malicious GitHub issues crafted to exploit autonomous coding agents trigger code injection or data exfiltration in production tools.
items.unproven: Evaluation against three agent implementations and two model families; generalization to agents not tested and deployment mitigations not assessed.

items.title: Toward cryptographically verifiable authorization for autonomous AI agents: A security hypothesis, preliminary formal model, and proof-of-concept implementation
items.dek: Cryptographically Verifiable Agent Authorization formalizes policy-bound authorization as a zk-SNARK relation, directly applicable to AI agents in SDLC.
items.unproven: Scalability and performance overhead in production deployments; compatibility with existing SDLC orchestration and policy frameworks.

items.title: Leaky Language Models: Stealing Architecture and Inference Optimizations via Per-Token Timing
items.dek: Token-generation timing from remote LLM APIs reveals speculative decoding, draft context windows, and transformer layer counts.
items.unproven: Demonstrated only on Google Gemini; generalization to other providers' APIs and defenses against timing side-channels not explored.

items.title: Security Vulnerability Patterns in AI-Generated Code: A Cross-Model Comparative Study
items.dek: All automation code from ChatGPT, Copilot, and Gemini contained CVSS-scorable vulnerabilities; risk uniform across models, not tool-specific.
items.unproven: Limited to three models and automation domain; generalization to code-generation at scale and to custom enterprise prompts not established.

items.title: My security camera shipped a GitHub admin token in its login page
items.dek: Security camera shipped GitHub admin token in login page HTML.
items.unproven: whether this affects other devices from the same vendor or product line

items.title: Unconditional Unclonable Encryption
items.dek: Information-theoretic unconditional construction of one-time unclonable encryption for one-bit messages with efficient operations.
items.unproven: Scalability to multi-bit or practical message spaces; practical utility compared to conditional constructions.

items.title: Benchmarking Agents for Proving Theorems in Quantum Algorithms and Quantum Information
items.dek: Four LLMs score 60.4 and 59.6 out of 100 on quantum algorithm and information theory theorem-proving benchmarks.
items.unproven: limited to four model families; no evidence the benchmark predicts real-world theorem assistance for applied developers

items.title: A solution to 2-copy distillability of Werner states
items.dek: Werner states are 2-copy distillable if and only if 1-copy distillable, resolving an open problem.
items.unproven: Pure theory result; no hardware demonstration or practical entanglement-distillation protocol.

items.title: Efficient classical simulation of large-scale unitary cluster Jastrow circuits
items.dek: Polynomial-time classical algorithm simulates single-layer unitary cluster Jastrow circuits, matching 77-qubit IBM experiment.
items.unproven: Algorithm applies only to single-layer circuits; implications for multi-layer or fault-tolerant quantum chemistry unclear.

items.title: Why Some Quantum States Cannot Be Recovered
items.dek: Unrecoverable quantum information called ghost correlations exhibits universal error floor and spectral phase transition.
items.unproven: whether the theoretical predictions hold for realistic noise and whether the results apply beyond the theoretical model studied

items.title: Agree on the Model, Verify the Inference: GKR Protocols for HND-Based Transformer Inference
items.dek: GKR-HND protocol verifies Transformer inference against model substitution by combining registered-weight checks with delegated computation.
items.unproven: Practical performance cost; real-world threat model for outsourced inference in financial services; assumed honest verifier is restrictive.

items.title: Buzz to Boom: Detecting Message Progression Vulnerabilities in Electron Applications via Segmented Directed Fuzzing
items.dek: Directed fuzzing framework detects multi-step Electron inter-process message attacks that propagate attacker input to privileged APIs.
items.unproven: Evaluated on synthetic Electron testbed; no evidence of real-world Electron application scanning or comparison to existing Electron security tooling.

items.title: QuantumChain: Blockchain-Backed Quantum Federated Learning for Financial Fraud Detection
items.dek: Hybrid quantum-classical federated learning for fraud detection with blockchain auditability.
items.unproven: single financial dataset; quantum advantage not isolated from architectural choices; no comparison to tuned classical baselines; commercial framing

items.title: Cautious optimism for deep parameterized quantum circuits
items.dek: Parameterized quantum circuits exhibit double-descent generalization behavior as model size increases.
items.unproven: Tested only on re-uploading PQCs; no demonstration of practical advantage over classical baselines at scale or on non-toy datasets.

items.title: Floquet Reservoir Engineering for Remote Logical Entanglement
items.dek: Floquet dissipative protocols stabilize remote entanglement of logical qubits in superconducting circuits.
items.unproven: Theoretical design with superconducting circuit sketch; no experimental validation or comparison to existing distillation methods.

items.title: Quasiparticle-induced transitions in a fluxonium qubit
items.dek: Fluxonium decoherence from quasiparticles requires accounting for junction gap asymmetry in transition-rate modeling.
items.unproven: Isolated measurement on one device; generalizability to other qubit architectures or fabrication processes unknown.

items.title: Classifying Topology via Edge-State Pure Thermalization
items.dek: Topological edge states drive cavity to Gibbs state while bulk states enable coherent operation in micromaser.
items.unproven: Demonstrated on small SSH chain and four-qubit superconducting implementation; scaling and practical utility unestablished.

items.title: Fluctuation-Induced Bistability in the Dissipative Dynamics of Generic Cavity-Matter Quantum Systems
items.dek: Fluctuation-induced bistability is generic in cavity-matter systems coupled through photonic-many-body resonances.
items.unproven: Unified mechanism identified across models but tested on small systems; experimental observation and control remain open.

items.title: Device-Independent Self-Testing of the Three-Qubit CCZ Hypergraph State
items.dek: Self-testing of three-qubit CCZ hypergraph state requires five measurement contexts and explicit Bell inequality.
items.unproven: Theoretical proof; no device-independent experimental demonstration or practical protocol for state certification.

items.title: Mixed-Binary Quadratic Programming via QUBO Sampling without Continuous-Variable Binarization
items.dek: QUBO formulation avoids discretization of continuous variables in quantum optimization problems.
items.unproven: whether the method scales beyond small instances or outperforms existing solvers on problems relevant to production systems

items.title: Space-division multiplexed quantum key distribution exploiting multi-plane light conversion for few-mode fibers
items.dek: Multi-plane light conversion enables space-division multiplexing of QKD over few-mode fiber.
items.unproven: whether the approach works at distances and key rates required for production quantum networks, or whether it scales beyond two channels

items.title: Tailoring optical Schrödinger cat states via orientation-dependent high-harmonic generation in $\rm{H}_2^+$
items.dek: Molecular orientation controls Schrödinger cat state generation via high-harmonic generation.

items.title: Entanglement asymmetry and quantum Mpemba effect for Kramers-Wannier duality
items.dek: Entanglement asymmetry quantifies Kramers-Wannier symmetry breaking; quantum Mpemba effect emerges in quenches.
items.unproven: whether the effect survives realistic dissipation or occurs in physical systems beyond the transverse-field Ising chain

noise.title: The arguments against open source AI are bad
noise.dek: Opinion piece arguing against open-source AI licensing restrictions.

noise.title: Kimi K3 exploited the latest Redis server
noise.dek: Social media post alleges exploitation of Redis without technical details or PoC.
noise.unproven: exploitation technique, affected versions, reproducibility, real-world impact
